parameters.query:
select r.litellm_model, r.temperature, r.max_tokens, r.nudge,
       r.price_in_usd_per_1k, r.price_out_usd_per_1k, r.fallback_price_per_unit, r.impact,
       p.resolution
from model_routing r
left join image_gen_params p on p.impact = r.impact
where r.impact in ($1, '__default__') and r.modality = $2 and r.active = true
order by (r.impact = $1) desc
limit 1;

nodes.name: Call LiteLLM
nodes.notes: Multimodal (ADR-036 Block 5): messages now comes from Resolve Routing (content array with optional image_url parts). onError=continueErrorOutput: a non-2xx routes to Fallback to Opus (ADR-037).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ model: $json.litellm_model, messages: $json.messages, max_tokens: $json.max_tokens }, $json.temperature != null ? { temperature: $json.temperature } : {})) }}

nodes.name: Call Log Model Run
nodes.notes: ADR-035: the shared agent_runs writer also owns cost math (FX, PLN, token-price fallback). Returns cost_pln_total + cost_missing.

value.message: Degradacja w Invoke Model: fallback na Opus (model podstawowy zawiódł), routing fail-safe, i/lub brak danych o koszcie.
value.details: =fell_back_to_opus={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.fell_back_to_opus }}; routing_default_used={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.routing_default_used }}; routing_row_missing={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.routing_row_missing }}; cost_missing={{ $('Call Log Model Run').first().json.cost_missing }}; impact={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.impact }}; model={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.model_used }}; task={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.clickup_task_id }}

nodes.name: Fallback to Opus
nodes.notes: Auto-fallback (ADR-037): primary model call failed -> retry once on Opus, to opus-4-8-direct. Uses the same multimodal messages from Resolve Routing (ADR-036 Block 5). Success feeds Parse Response with fell_back=true -> WARN. If Opus ALSO fails it throws -> Execute LLM Call CRITICAL.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'haxe-opus-4-8-direct', messages: $('Resolve Routing').first().json.messages, max_tokens: $('Resolve Routing').first().json.max_tokens }) }}

nodes.name: Routing Missing?
nodes.notes: 0-row routing guard: true when Lookup Routing matched nothing and Resolve Routing fell back to its safety-net model (routing_row_missing). True -> CRITICAL alert. Both branches reconverge to Check Degradation so Shape Output stays the sole leaf (sub-workflow return determinism).

nodes.name: Alert Routing Missing
nodes.notes: CRITICAL via Post Alert (v1): the model_routing table has no row for this impact/modality/PD combo. The run still replies via Resolve Routing's safety-net model, so this is loud-but-non-blocking. Reconverges to Check Degradation (not a leaf).

value.message: Brak trasy w model_routing dla tej kombinacji (impact × modalność) — użyto modelu zapasowego. Uzupełnij model_routing.
value.details: =task={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; impact={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.impact }}; modalność={{ $('When Called').first().json.modality }}; model_zapasowy={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.model_used }}

nodes.name: Retry Text-Only
nodes.notes: Block 6 (ADR-036): final safety net. Reached only when BOTH the routed model AND the Opus fallback failed AND images were present (a corrupt/1x1/unprocessable image 4xxs every image-bearing call). Retries text-only on Opus with images stripped + a [BRAK] marker (messages_text_only from Resolve Routing) -> Parse Response sets image_unprocessable -> WARN multimodal/image-unprocessable. No onError here: if THIS also fails it throws -> Execute LLM Call CRITICAL, so a genuine non-image failure is NOT masked.

nodes.name: Image Unprocessable?
nodes.notes: Block 6: true when the routed model could not consume the input image and the run degraded to a text-only retry. True -> WARN multimodal/image-unprocessable. Both branches reconverge into Call Log Model Run so Shape Output stays the sole branch-free leaf (sub-workflow return determinism), mirroring Routing Missing? -> Check Degradation.

nodes.name: Alert Image Unprocessable
nodes.notes: Block 6 WARN via Post Alert (v1): a corrupt/non-vision input image was dropped and the answer was produced text-only. Loud-but-non-blocking; reconverges to Call Log Model Run (not a leaf).

value.message: Obraz nieczytelny na bieżącym providerze — odpowiedź wygenerowana tylko z tekstu.
value.details: =task={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; images_dropped={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.images_dropped }}; impact={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.impact }}; model={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.model_used }}

nodes.name: Call Image Gen
nodes.notes: Block 9: tiered image generation via LiteLLM /v1/images/generations. model/size/quality from Resolve Routing (impact, modality=image). onError=continueErrorOutput -> single fallback hop to gemini-2.5-flash-image.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ model: $json.image_model, prompt: $json.image_prompt, size: $json.size, n: 1 }, $json.image_quality ? { quality: $json.image_quality } : {})) }}

nodes.name: Fallback Image Gen
nodes.notes: Block 9: single cross-provider fallback hop (cheap reliable floor model) when the primary image model errors. onError=continueErrorOutput so a total failure still reaches Parse Image -> success:false (caller drops the block, no throw).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'vertex_ai/gemini-2.5-flash-image', prompt: $('Resolve Routing').first().json.image_prompt, size: $('Resolve Routing').first().json.size, n: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: Parse Image
nodes.notes: Block 9: normalise one image attempt; success gated on data[0].b64_json payload, not HTTP status. Feeds Normalize Model Result.

nodes.name: Normalize Model Result
nodes.notes: Block 9: single convergence of the text + image branches into one uniform schema. Keeps Shape Output the sole branch-free leaf (return determinism).

nodes.name: Alert Image Degrade
nodes.notes: Block 9 WARN: an image generation stepped down to the fallback model. Loud-but-non-blocking; reconverges to Cost Header Missing? (not a leaf).

value.message: Degradacja generacji obrazu: model podstawowy zawiódł, użyto modelu zapasowego (gemini-2.5-flash-image).
value.details: =task={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.clickup_task_id }}; impact={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.impact }}; model={{ $('Normalize Model Result').first().json.model_used }}

nodes.name: Alert Image Cost Missing
nodes.notes: Block 9 WARN: the live x-litellm-response-cost header was absent for an image gen; cost fell back to token-math or the per-image floor. Reconverges to Routing Missing? (not a leaf).
